name: Heavy Armour
description: Increase the Defense characteristic of the bearer by 2, and decrease their Move characteristic by 1.

name: Light Armour
description: Increase the Defense characteristic of the bearer by 1.

name: Shield
description: Increase the Defense characteristic of the bearer by 1.

name: Rope and Hook
description: When the bearer climbs during a move action, do not count the vertical distance as double.

name: Lucky Charm
description: Once per battle, when the bearer is targeted by an attack action and after hit rolls have been made, you may turn one critical hit into a hit.

name: Lantern
description: Friendly fighters may re-roll failed Bravery tests while within 3” of this fighter. However, this fighter must reduce their Defense characteristic by 1 when targeted by ranged attacks.

name: Elven Cloak
description: While wearing this cloak, a fighter is considered to have the 'Stealthy' trait.

name: Mordheim Map
description: The player controlling this warband can always decide which battlefield edge to deploy their warband from, regardless of being the Attacker or the Defender. If both players have a Mordheim Map, roll off.

name: Holy Relic
description: Start each battle with one additional Wyrd Dice.

name: Master Wrought Weapon
description: Purchase a weapon from the fighter’s faction entry, and increase its gold coin cost by 100 gold coin. Then, add 1 to the hit and critical hit characteristics of that weapon.

name: Blessed Water
description: Use this item in the 'Present Warbands' step. Select a weapon equipped by the bearer. Until the end of the battle, that weapon gains the blessed weapon rule.

name: Crimson Shade
description: Use this item in the 'Present Warbands' step. Until the end of the battle, increase this fighter's Move and Fight characteristics by 1. In the aftermath sequence, roll a dice. On a 1-2, the fighter gains the Kleptomaniac trait.

name: Dark Venom
description: Use this item after allocating damage to an enemy fighter with a critical hit. That fighter must forfeit one action or suffer d6 damage points.

name: Familiar
description: A Wizard may discard their Familiar to ignore the effects of a single roll on the magical calamity table. Declare this after making the calamity roll but before resolving its effects.

name: Healing Draught
description: Use this item when making a Wait action  to immediately use the ‘Respite’ ability without needing or spending ability dice to do so. Treat the value of that ability as a 6.

name: Mad Cap Mushrooms
description: Use this item in the 'Present Warbands' step. Until the end of the battle, increase this fighter's Fight characteristic by 3. It also gains the Stupidity trait for the duration of the battle.

name: Smoke Bomb
description: A fighter may use this item to make a free Retreat action. During that action, enemy fighters within 3” of the bearer cannot make reactions.

name: Superior Blackpowder
description: Use this item during the ‘Present Warbands’ step. Until the end of the battle, remove the Unreliable weapon rule from all equipped weapons.
